test_autotune_nevergrad: test the Autotuner with nevergrad algorithm on an LLVM environment using the cbench crc32 benchmark
create_autotuner_instance: create an Autotuner with nevergrad algorithm targeting codesize optimization and a 3 second search time
run_autotuner_on_env: run the Autotuner against a CompilerGym LLVM environment to optimize compiler pass flags
create_llvm_env: create a CompilerGym LLVM environment with IrInstructionCount reward space and reset with a benchmark
verify_autotuner_result: verify the autotuner result benchmark, walltime, commandline, and episode reward assertions
